additional_source_observations.observation: A challenger who clears round five in under one minute can receive highest-access authentication and open the sixth/final challenge.
Final challenge instance has a black lake, starless dark space and mechanical throne. The protagonist encounters an invisible boundary after about 3 km of flight; exact dimensions remain unknown.

structures.status: Existing source-territory landmark; after use of a Legendary Tree Demon Heart and more than 1,000 cumulative years of accelerated growth, its tree spirit awakens and it grows to about 1,000 m tall (Ch869). The new consciousness speaks with the source party in Ch870–871.
structures.observed_function: Ch760 recruitment blessing doubles vitality/生命力. Ch869 combat XP +100%; territory soil becomes Spirit-Rich Fertile Soil, with +50% plant survival and growth. Ch870–871 tree-spirit Revelation and Origin Tracing.
structures.notes: The source calls the landmark 苍白圣树 and the recruitment blessing 苍白之树; retained as one contextual record without asserting a separate effect contract. Ch869–871 record the awakened tree-spirit state and effects for this same landmark; this updates STR-0010 without creating another structure. Source-world only, not LL01 T0.

source_evidence.detail: First source-territory observation, about 50 m tall; recruitment blessing recorded.
Tree Demon Heart adds 300 accelerated years; cumulative accelerated growth exceeds 1,000 years; tree spirit awakens and tree reaches about 1,000 m.
Tree spirit describes destiny and Revelation; futures are possibilities.
Origin Tracing locates six targets; the tree spirit sleeps after heavy power expenditure.

observed_contents.agricultural_area: beside river, newly planted crop shoots
observed_contents.ceremonial_center: A round, red-and-gold City Hall about 200 m across and tens of metres tall; exterior reliefs depict the Pale Sacred Tree, Legendary allies, mammoths, bears and griffins. Its huge roof is placed in Ch840.

structures.notes: The source calls it a giant city but provides no proper name. Dimensions and buildings are source-world observations only. The planned opening ceremony was also described as a possible security crisis due to an expected demigod breakthrough. The proper name 星火城 is first supplied in Ch840. The territory claim and 500 km protection radius describe source-novel world state only.
